summary: Revised implementation plan where the Heartline coaster track physically plunges from the Crystal Tunnel down into the submerged Ocean Coral Reef Basin (beneath the ocean water surface), travels underwater through the 7 storyboard stages (First Reef, Living Reef, Coral Passage, Heart Reef, and Underwater Heartline 'I LOVE YOU' Element), and rises back out of the ocean water to the open sky.
